metadata.question: Does the built-up area east of the Nile River in Cairo increase from July 1984 to September 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Location: East of Nile River in Cairo (approximately 30°N, 31.3°E) - Time Period: Compare July 1984 to September 2019 - Data Source: Landsat (available since 1984; Landsat 5 TM for 1984, Landsat 8 OLI for 2019) - Built-up Detection: Use NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) or similar spectral index to quantify urban area 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Cloud mask is essential to avoid confusing clouds with built-up areas - Use QA band for Landsat to filter clouds and shadows - Focus on pixels with clear/clear confidence 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Error**: - Valid Zero: Both time periods have valid pixels, but built-up area did not increase (NDBI values similar or lower) - Error (C3): If calculated values are `None`, `NaN`, or outside valid ranges (NDBI should be -1 to 1) - Empty Collection (C1): If no images available for either period - No Valid Pixels (C2): If after cloud masking, pixel count is 0 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define study area: east of Nile River in Cairo const cairoPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([31.35, 30.05]); const geometry = cairoPoint.buffer(15000); // ~15 km buffer // Define time periods const date1Start = '1984-07-01'; const date1End = '1984-07-31'; const date2Start = '2019-09-01'; const date2End = '2019-09-30'; // Function to mask clouds in Landsat 5 TM function maskCloudsLandsat5(image) { const qa = image.select('QA'); const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0); return image.updateMask(cloud); } // Function to mask clouds in Landsat 8 OLI function maskCloudsLandsat8(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloud); } // Function to calculate NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) function calcNDBI(image) { const ndbi = image.normalizedDifference(['SWIR1', 'NIR']); return ndbi.rename('NDBI'); } // Acquire Landsat 5 TM for July 1984 let col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .map(maskCloudsLandsat5); const size1984 = col1984.size().getInfo(); print('1984 July Images Found: ' + size1984); if (size1984 === 0) { print('No images available for July 1984.'); print('C1'); return; } // Calculate NDBI for 1984 const ndbi1984 = col1984.map(calcNDBI).mean(); const count1984 = ndbi1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); print('1984 Valid Pixels: ' + count1984); if (count1984 === 0 || count1984 === null) { print('No valid pixels after cloud masking in 1984.'); print('C2'); return; } const mean1984 = ndbi1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); // Acquire Landsat 8 OLI for September 2019 let col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .map(maskCloudsLandsat8); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); print('2019 September Images Found: ' + size2019); if (size2019 === 0) { print('No images available for September 2019.'); print('C1'); return; } // Calculate NDBI for 2019 const ndbi2019 = col2019.map(calcNDBI).mean(); const count2019 = ndbi2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); print('2019 Valid Pixels: ' + count2019); if (count2019 === 0 || count2019 === null) { print('No valid pixels after cloud masking in 2019.'); print('C2'); return; } const mean2019 = ndbi2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI').getInfo(); // Validation print('1984 Mean NDBI: ' + (mean1984 !== null ? mean1984.toFixed(4) : 'null')); print('2019 Mean NDBI: ' + (mean2019 !== null ? mean2019.toFixed(4) : 'null')); if (mean1984 === null || mean2019 === null || isNaN(mean1984) || isNaN(mean2019)) { print('C3'); return; } // Check if NDBI values are within valid range if (mean1984 < -1 || mean1984 > 1 || mean2019 < -1 || mean2019 > 1) { print('C3'); return; } const difference = mean2019 - mean1984; print('NDBI Increase: ' + difference.toFixed(4)); if (mean2019 > mean1984) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
